# mergegateway_export_destination (Resource)

Manages a telemetry export destination: where the Gateway sends request traces (OTLP spans, and optionally metrics), such as Datadog, Grafana Cloud or your own OTLP collector. Needs the telemetry export feature enabled for the organization. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later: the secret is write-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Ephemeral variables (Terraform 1.10+) also keep the secrets out of saved plan files.
variable "datadog_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "grafana_cloud_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

# Send request traces to Datadog LLM Observability, without prompts and
# completions (privacy_mode defaults to true), for 1 request in 4.
resource "mergegateway_export_destination" "datadog" {
  name        = "Datadog"
  site        = "datadoghq.com"
  ml_app      = "support-bot"
  sample_rate = 0.25

  # Write-only (Terraform 1.11+): never stored in the plan or state. Terraform
  # sends the secret on create, and again only when the version changes: to
  # rotate it, set the new key and bump the version, such as to 2.
  credential_secret_wo         = var.datadog_api_key
  credential_secret_wo_version = 1
}

# Grafana Cloud authenticates with an instance ID beside the token.
resource "mergegateway_export_destination" "grafana" {
  name                         = "Grafana Cloud"
  otlp_preset                  = "grafana"
  site                         = "prod-us-east-0"
  credential_username          = "123456"
  credential_secret_wo         = var.grafana_cloud_token
  credential_secret_wo_version = 1
  metrics_enabled              = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `credential_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The API key or token the destination authenticates with. Write-only (Terraform 1.11+): Terraform sends it to the API but never stores it in the plan or state. It is sent on create, and on update only when `credential_secret_wo_version` changes: to rotate it, set the new secret and change the version. The API never returns it, so a secret changed outside Terraform isn't detected; `credential_hint` shows the stored secret's last 4 characters.
- `credential_secret_wo_version` (Number) Set with `credential_secret_wo`. Change it, to any other number, to send `credential_secret_wo` again, such as to rotate it.
- `name` (String) The destination's name, unique in the organization. The API trims surrounding whitespace.

### Optional

- `credential_username` (String) `grafana` only, and required for it: the Grafana Cloud instance ID. Not a secret. The API trims surrounding whitespace.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the destination receives telemetry. Defaults to `true`.
- `kind` (String) The export protocol. Only `otlp` exists today, and it is the default. Changing it replaces the destination.
- `metrics_enabled` (Boolean) Also export metrics. Datadog and Grafana Cloud bill these separately. Defaults to `false`.
- `ml_app` (String) `datadog` only: the `ml_app` tag on exported spans. Leave it out for none. The API trims surrounding whitespace.
- `otlp_endpoint` (String) `generic` only, and required for it: the https URL of your OTLP collector, such as `https://otel.example.com/v1`. The API stores it with a lowercase host, no `:443` port, no trailing slash and no surrounding whitespace; either form works, and the state keeps the one written.
- `otlp_preset` (String) Where spans go: `datadog` (the default), `grafana` (Grafana Cloud) or `generic` (any OTLP collector; needs an enterprise plan). Changing it replaces the destination.
- `privacy_mode` (Boolean) Leave prompts and completions out of exported spans. Defaults to `true`.
- `sample_rate` (Number) The fraction of requests exported, from 0.0001 to 1. Defaults to `1`.
- `site` (String) `datadog`: the Datadog site, such as `datadoghq.com`. `grafana`: the Grafana Cloud zone, such as `prod-us-east-0`. Required for both; not allowed for `generic`. The API stores it in lowercase; either case works, and the state keeps the one written.

### Read-Only

- `consecutive_failures` (Number) Failed deliveries in a row, as of the last refresh.
- `created_at` (String) When the destination was created (RFC 3339).
- `credential_hint` (String) The last 4 characters of the stored secret.
- `delivery_suspended_until` (String) Set while delivery is paused after repeated failures (RFC 3339), as of the last refresh.
- `id` (String) The export destination's ID.
- `last_error_at` (String) The last failed delivery (RFC 3339), as of the last refresh.
- `last_error_message` (String) Why the last delivery failed, as of the last refresh.
- `last_success_at` (String) The last successful delivery (RFC 3339), as of the last refresh.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization that owns the destination.
- `updated_at` (String) When the destination was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an export destination by its ID. The API never returns the secret, so
# after an import set credential_secret_wo and credential_secret_wo_version in
# the configuration: the first apply sends the secret again.
terraform import mergegateway_export_destination.datadog 7c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
```
